_comment: The claude.ai pages, all retired. The café's first home (kittychat-cafe) was retired on 5 October 2026: the café is the gateway's now (CLAUDE.md, Where the café lives; docs/artifact.md). Don't republish it unless she asks; it is kept for the licensed art a cloud session reads back, and, until the harness reports to the gateway, what the house rules save. Her two quiz pages, the litter box quiz and the decisions quiz, are retired now that the queen's quest log deals the cards; their URLs stay for the answers in their databases (litterbox/README.md).
